root_cause: The initial trend-only Foresight studio lacked a contextual overlay for the existing authenticated tenant-specific Powerhouse entrepreneurial intelligence. Blind reuse of canonical external signals would risk falsely attributing platform-wide impacts to a customer.
prevention: Read only through existing authenticated /api/portal-ondernemersdata; require returned authenticatedTenant to equal intelligence.tenantId; accept only SCORED, recent, tenant-owned impact rows linked to current source signals. Keep external unscored signals and proposed actions separate. Never convert these signals into numerical causal forecast adjustments, Heartbeat SLAs or realised outcomes.

evidence.source: portal-state-eu tenant-scoped entrepreneur_intelligence via Netlify Identity, zero new scheduler or tables
evidence.scope: No global provider signal may become scored tenant impact without matching tenant_id and portal identity
evidence.production: Pending independent protected CI, exact deploy and authenticated readback
